map.非诉业务和诉讼有什么区别？: What is the difference between non-litigation and litigation?
map.非诉指不通过法院争议解决的法律服务（如融资、并购、合规），侧重交易设计与风险防范: Non-litigation means legal services not via court dispute resolution (e.g. financing, MA, compliance), focusing on deal design and risk prevention, no adversarial adjudication.
